semiconductor_relevance: High — Engis Japan specializes in high-precision lapping and grinding equipment essential for semiconductor wafer processing.
summary: Engis Japan provides advanced lapping and grinding technology tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-precision and high-quality processes. Their HVG-300ADM vertical grinding machine is designed for both laboratory and production scales, ensuring efficient processing of hard and brittle materials.
